# CHW Plant Sequence of Operations (Module CHW)

**Status:** Draft A for BAS specification. STE pass applied. Values marked "confirm" are my proposals, not given inputs.

**Test codes:** F = FAT with simulated I/O. S = SAT on live plant. R = document review.

## 1. Purpose and boundaries

The module controls the hospital chilled water plant. It covers chillers, primary pumps, condenser pumps, cooling towers, the bypass valve, and the supply and differential pressure setpoints.

**Basis:**
- Primary pumps and condenser pumps are headered, so any pump can serve any chiller.
- The tower cells are headered.
- Peak load is at or below the capacity of two chillers (see OI-01).

**Interfaces:**
- Upstream: AHU controllers (coil valve positions, cooling requests) and the emergency power ATS.
- Downstream: chiller control panels (hardwired start/stop and run status, plus comms for data).

**Out of scope:** Chiller internal safeties stay in the chiller panels. No SIS function is identified for this module. If an SRS adds one, reference it here and do not specify it here.

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-CHW-001 | Keep chilled water to the surgery suites during a single failure of any chiller, CHWP, CWP, tower cell, DPT-710, or FIT-702. | F, S |
| FR-CHW-002 | Keep one available chiller, one CHWP, and one CWP in standby above the running count. | F |
| FR-CHW-003 | Show "N+1 lost" when no standby chiller is available (FR-CHW-081). | F |
| FR-CHW-004 | Select equipment automatically. Rotate duty by lowest runtime on start and highest runtime on stop. Let the operator fix the lead. | F |

## 4. States and transitions (ISA-106)

### 4.1 Plant states

| State | Entry permissives | Exits | Initiator | Automation level |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| STOPPED | Stop sequence complete, or power restore | To STARTING | Auto, or operator | Automatic |
| STARTING | Enable true. Cooling requests at or above SP-44. At least one chiller, CHWP, and CWP available. | To RUNNING, HOLDING, ABORTING | Auto, or operator | Automatic |
| RUNNING | Lead chiller run proven | To STOPPING, HOLDING | Auto | Automatic |
| STOPPING | No demand for SP-45, or operator stop | To STOPPED | Auto, or operator | Operator-prompted for operator stop |
| HOLDING | Recoverable fault in any other state | To prior state (operator Resume), ABORTING (SP-46 expiry or operator) | Auto | Operator-prompted |
| ABORTING / ABORTED | Unrecoverable fault: no CHWP or no CWP available | ABORTED to STOPPED by operator reset only | Auto, or operator | Operator-prompted |

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-CHW-010 | Make each transition only when its permissives are true. | F |
| FR-CHW-011 | In HOLDING, freeze staging. Keep running equipment running. | F |
| FR-CHW-012 | In ABORTING, stop chillers by SEQ-5. Keep available pumps running until SP-48 expires. | F |
| FR-CHW-013 | Latch ABORTED until an operator reset. | F |
| FR-CHW-014 | Do not require the plant to leave RUNNING when a standby device takes over a failed device. | F |

### 4.2 Chiller states (CH-n)

| State | Entry | Exit |
|---|---|---|
| UNAVAILABLE | HOA not Auto, latched fault, status bad, or excluded by XS-ATS | To STOPPED after operator reset |
| STOPPED | Available, minimum off time (SP-21) elapsed | To STARTING |
| STARTING | Valves proven, flow proven, start command sent | To RUNNING, UNAVAILABLE (SP-26 expiry) |
| RUNNING | Run status proven | To STOPPING, UNAVAILABLE (trip) |
| STOPPING | Stop command sent | To STOPPED |

Pumps and tower cells use the same states without the minimum timers.

## 5. Regulatory control

No tuning values. All PID blocks need anti-windup.

| Loop | PV | Output | Action | Mode behavior | Cascade / override |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Differential pressure | DPT-710 (or DPT-710B) to SP-03 | Common speed for all running CHWPs, SP-08 to SP-09 | Reverse: DP low raises speed | Manual: operator sets speed | None. Fallback per FR-CHW-060. |
| Minimum flow | FIT-702 | FCV-701 position | Reverse: flow low opens valve | Manual: operator sets position. Hold position while STARTING. | Setpoint = running chillers × SP-04 × (1 + SP-07) |
| CHWST | TT-720 | Leaving-water setpoint to every running chiller | Chiller panel regulates | Manual: operator enters setpoint | Setpoint from CHWST reset |
| CWST | TT-731 to SP-27 | Common fan speed for enabled cells, SP-29 to 100% | Direct: CWST high raises speed | Manual: operator sets speed | Below SP-28: stop fans. Restart above SP-27. |

| FR-CHW-023 | Include all surgery AHU coil valves in CHWST reset. Ignore other bad valve signals. | F |

## 6. Sequences

### 6.1 SEQ-1 Plant start

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Select lead chiller, CHWP, CWP, tower cell | Selection valid | SP-49 | HOLDING, alarm FR-CHW-097 |
| 2 | Open XV-71n, XV-72n, XV-73n | All proven open | SP-24 | Select next chiller, repeat. None left: HOLDING. |
| 3 | Start CHWP and CWP at minimum speed | Both run proven | SP-23 | Start next available pump. None left: ABORTING. |
| 4 | Release DP loop and FCV-701 loop | FIT-702 at or above running chillers × SP-04 | SP-25 | HOLDING, alarm FR-CHW-090 |
| 5 | Release tower fan loop | Condenser flow proven | SP-25 | Start next available CWP. None left: HOLDING. |
| 6 | Send CHWST setpoint. Start lead chiller. | Run status proven | SP-26 | Mark chiller UNAVAILABLE. Start standby chiller by SEQ-2 step 2. |
| 7 | Release staging | Plant state set to RUNNING | SP-49 | HOLDING |

### 6.2 SEQ-2 Stage up

Start on any condition below. Block the start if state is not RUNNING or no chiller is available.
- Average load of running chillers above SP-12 for SP-13.
- CHWST above setpoint by SP-16 for SP-17.
- Pumps at SP-09 and DPT-710 below SP-03 by SP-18 for SP-19.

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Select available chiller with lowest runtime | SP-21 elapsed | SP-49 | Alarm FR-CHW-082 |
| 2 | Open XV-71n, XV-72n, XV-73n | All proven open | SP-24 | Select next chiller |
| 3 | Start next CHWP and CWP | Both run proven | SP-23 | Start next available pump |
| 4 | Raise minimum flow setpoint for new count | FIT-702 at or above new minimum | SP-25 | Open FCV-701 fully. Alarm FR-CHW-090. |
| 5 | Start chiller. Add tower cell. | Run status proven | SP-26 | Mark UNAVAILABLE. Go to step 1. |

### 6.3 SEQ-3 Stage down

Start when all of the following are true:
- Total chiller load is below SP-14 of the remaining capacity for SP-15.
- CHWST is within SP-16 of setpoint.
- SP-20 has elapsed for the chiller to stop.
- More than one chiller is running.

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Select running chiller with highest runtime. Send stop. | Off proven | SP-26 | Send hardwired stop. Alarm FR-CHW-083. |
| 2 | Wait post-run delay | SP-48 elapsed | SP-48 | None |
| 3 | Stop one CWP and one CHWP. Remove one tower cell. | Stop proven | SP-23 | Alarm FR-CHW-084 |
| 4 | Close XV-71n, XV-72n, XV-73n | All proven closed | SP-24 | Alarm FR-CHW-094. Leave valves as found. |
| 5 | Lower minimum flow setpoint for new count | Setpoint updated | SP-49 | HOLDING |

### 6.4 SEQ-4 Failover (running chiller trips)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Detect trip or run status lost without command. Latch UNAVAILABLE. | Trip detected | SP-49 | None |
| 2 | Set CHWST setpoint to SP-01. Start SEQ-2 step 2 on the standby chiller. Skip stagger and stage-up delays. Keep vendor timers. | Standby run proven | SP-26 | Select next available chiller. None left: reduced capacity (FR-CHW-044). |
| 3 | Keep pump speed under DP control. Keep FCV-701 under minimum flow control. | CHWST within SP-16 of setpoint | SP-42 | Alarm FR-CHW-098 |

### 6.5 SEQ-5 Plant stop

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Send stop to all running chillers | All off proven | SP-26 | Send hardwired stop. Alarm FR-CHW-083. |
| 2 | Wait post-run delay | SP-48 elapsed | SP-48 | None |
| 3 | Stop CWPs and tower fans | Stop proven | SP-23 | Alarm FR-CHW-084 |
| 4 | Stop CHWPs. Close XV-71n, XV-72n, XV-73n. Open FCV-701. | All proven | SP-24 | Alarm FR-CHW-094 |

### 6.6 SEQ-6 Restart after power loss

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Set all outputs off. Read stored running count. If XS-ATS shows emergency power, limit the count to equipment on emergency power. | Inputs valid | SP-49 | Use one chiller. Alarm FR-CHW-095. |
| 2 | Wait for power restore delay | SP-43 elapsed | SP-43 | None |
| 3 | Run SEQ-1 steps 2 to 5 for the first chiller | Flow proven | SP-25 | HOLDING |
| 4 | Start chillers one at a time, spaced by SP-22 | Count reaches stored count, or SP-26 expiry | SP-26 | Skip chiller. Mark UNAVAILABLE. |
| 5 | Release normal staging | State is RUNNING | SP-49 | HOLDING |

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-CHW-030 | Run SEQ-1 to SEQ-6 as written. | F, S |
| FR-CHW-031 | Never start a chiller before its flow is proven. | F |
| FR-CHW-032 | Start a chiller only after SP-21 elapsed, except in SEQ-4. | F |
| FR-CHW-033 | Never stage down below one running chiller. | F |
| FR-CHW-034 | Stage up and down one chiller at a time. | F |
| FR-CHW-035 | Store the running count so SEQ-6 can read it after power loss. | F |
| FR-CHW-044 | In reduced capacity, send a limit signal to non-critical AHU coil valves. Keep the surgery AHU valves unlimited (OI-05). | F |
| FR-CHW-045 | After SEQ-4, bring CHWST within SP-16 of setpoint within SP-42 when a standby chiller is available. | S |
